findings.title: Hardcoded 10MB client limit ignores per-type site settings
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/lib/utilities.js line 182, validateUploadedFile now uses hardcoded `10*1024` instead of `Discourse.SiteSettings['max_'+type+'_size_kb']`. The old code used max_image_size_kb for images and max_attachment_size_kb for attachments. Now both types are limited to 10MB: sites allowing e.g. 50MB attachments will incorrectly reject them client-side, and sites with e.g. 1-2MB limits will incorrectly allow them client-side only to fail later on the server with a confusing message showing 10240.

findings.title: 413 error handler shows wrong hardcoded limit
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/lib/utilities.js line 246, the 413 handler now reports hardcoded `10*1024` instead of `Discourse.SiteSettings.max_image_size_kb`. The displayed max_size_kb will be wrong whenever the admin configured a different limit, misleading users about why the upload was rejected.

findings.title: API URL download limit hardcoded to 10MB bypasses admin setting
findings.body: In app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb line 55, FileHelper.download limit was changed from `SiteSetting.max_image_size_kb.kilobytes` to hardcoded `10.megabytes`. If admin sets a smaller limit the server still fetches/downloads/processes up to 10MB (extra bandwidth/disk/CPU and policy bypass), and if admin allows larger than 10MB the download is needlessly truncated/failed.

findings.title: In-place image downsize corrupts tempfile and uses stale size
findings.body: In app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb line 67, `OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, tempfile.path, ...)` uses the same path for input and output. External `convert from[0] ... to` can truncate/replace the output before reading finishes, corrupting the upload. After the external rewrite the open Tempfile descriptor may still point at the old inode while `tempfile.size` is stale, so the `while tempfile.size > limit` check and final `Upload.create_for(..., tempfile.size)` can use wrong size/bytes. Return value is also ignored, so on convert failure it loops 5 times doing expensive convert+ImageOptim work then fails late. Use a separate temp file, check success, and stat `File.size(path)`.

findings.title: Large SVG uploads sent through ImageMagick rasterizer
findings.body: In app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb line 64, the auto-downsize guard is true for any `FileHelper.is_image?(filename)` including `.svg`, and then runs `OptimizedImage.downsize` via `convert -resize`. Elsewhere in app/models/optimized_image.rb lines 45-47 SVGs are explicitly excluded from ImageMagick (just copied) because convert rasterizes them. A large SVG over the limit will therefore be mangled/converted instead of preserved or rejected; SVGs should be skipped in the downsize loop.

findings.title: Duplicate downsize definition removes 4-arg overload
findings.body: In app/models/optimized_image.rb lines 145 and 149 there are two `self.downsize` definitions: one taking `(from,to,max_width,max_height,opts)` and one taking `(from,to,dimensions,opts)`. In Ruby the last definition wins, so the 4-arg version is dead code. Any existing caller using `downsize(from,to,width,height)` now raises ArgumentError (wrong number of arguments). Keep one method supporting both arities or different names.
